provenance_quote: Translocation of Helicobacter pylori CagA into Gastric Epithelial Cells by Type IV Secretion
notes: Crossref: Odenbreit et al 2000 Science 287:1497-1500, DOI resolves. UniProt P55980 = cagA / HP_0547, H. pylori 26695 (matches organism; HP_RS02695 is RefSeq locus for HP_0547). Title + abstract establish CagA as T4SS-translocated substrate. Identity fields correct.

provenance_quote: a large group of effectors (Lpg0103/VipF, Leg0208/LegK4, Lpg0437/Ceg14, Lpg1368/Lgt1, Lpg1488/Lgt3, Lpg2504/SidI, and Lpg2862/Lgt2) shown to manipulate eukaryotic protein translation
notes: DOI 10.1038/s44320-024-00076-z = PMID 39562741 / PMC11696984, Patel et al 2024 Mol Syst Biol, title 'Global atlas of predicted functional domains in Legionella pneumophila Dot/Icm translocated effectors'. Verbatim quote located in full text naming Lpg0437/Ceg14 as a Dot/Icm (T4SS) translocated effector. uniprot blank (na). LPG_RS02190 = RefSeq locus for lpg0437.

provenance_quote: The effector proteins (CBU0021, CBU0937, CBU1823, CBU1825 and CBU2013) were mainly associated with autophagy
notes: DOI 10.1371/journal.ppat.1010660 = PMID 35816513 / PMC9273094, Fu et al 2022 PLoS Pathog. Paper builds a PPI map of 53 Coxiella Dot/Icm T4SS effectors; CBU0937 is listed among them (verbatim quote located in full text). UniProt Q83D09 = CBU_0937, C. burnetii RSA 493 (matches; BAB-style RefSeq CBU_0937). NOTE: paper names CBU0425 as 'CirB', not CBU0937 as 'CirD'; the gene label 'CirD' is not substantiated by this ref or UniProt (no CirD synonym). Effector identity and secretion status hold; CirD naming unverified, hence medium.

provenance_quote: the VirB/D4 system is also involved in the translocation of several effector proteins, including VirE2, VirE3 and VirF into the host cell cytoplasm
notes: DOI 10.1371/journal.ppat.1003948 = PMID 24626239 / PMC3953389, Padavannil et al 2014 PLoS Pathog. Abstract verbatim states VirB/D4 T4SS translocates VirE2, VirE3, VirF into host cytoplasm. UniProt P08061 = virE3, Agrobacterium fabrum C58 (matches organism; ATU_RS23890 RefSeq). Quote matches ledger. Confirmed.

provenance_quote: These Bartonella-translocated effector proteins (Beps) A-G are encoded together with the VirB system and the T4S coupling protein VirD4 on a Bartonella-specific pathogenicity island
notes: DOI 10.1073/pnas.0406796102 = PMID 15642951 / PMC545523, Schulein et al 2005 PNAS. Abstract verbatim names Beps A-G as VirB T4SS substrates translocated into host cells. UniProt Q6G2A9 = bepA, B. henselae Houston-1, annotated 'Translocated into the host cell via the type IV secretion system (T4SS)'. Identity correct (AYT27_RS06820 RefSeq).

provenance_quote: BtpB is a novel Brucella effector that is translocated into host cells and interferes with activation of dendritic cells
notes: Secretion supported: DOI 10.3389/fcimb.2013.00028 = PMID 23847770, Salcedo et al 2013, BtpB is a Brucella effector translocated into host cells (VirB-dependent per ledger citation_quote). BUT cited uniprot Q2YNA0 = BAB1_0782 'DUF2069 domain-containing protein' (4 TM helices), NOT BtpB. BtpB in B. abortus 2308 = BAB1_0756 = Q2YN91 'TIR domain-containing protein' (277 aa), matching ledger RefSeq locus BAB_RS19660. fix: new_uniprot Q2YN91, new_locus BAB1_0756. (Note Q2YPC4/BAB1_0279 is btpA/Btp1/TcpB, the OTHER TIR protein, not BtpB.)

provenance_quote: resulted in the identification of the proteins encoded by BAB1_1652 (VceA) and BR1038/BAB1_1058 (VceC) as novel protein substrates of the Brucella T4SS
notes: DOI 10.1111/j.1365-2958.2008.06487.x = De Jong et al 2008 Mol Microbiol, resolves via Crossref. Abstract verbatim identifies BAB1_1058 (VceC) as a Brucella T4SS substrate. uniprot blank (na). BAB_RS26945 = RefSeq locus for BAB1_1058. Note ledger genome NC_007624.1 is chromosome II; BAB1_1058 is chromosome I, but locus identity and secretion claim hold; genome accession field not re-verified as defect since effector identity is correct.

provenance_quote: Anaplasma phagocytophilum Ats-1 Is Imported into Host Cell Mitochondria and Interferes with Apoptosis Induction
notes: DOI 10.1371/journal.ppat.1000774 = Niu et al 2010 PLoS Pathog, resolves via Crossref. UniProt Q2GJL5 = ats-1 'Anaplasma Translocated Substrate 1', APH_0859, A. phagocytophilum HZ (matches; APH_RS03430 RefSeq). Ats-1 identified as T4SS effector/translocated substrate. Identity correct.

notes: DOI 10.1111/j.1462-5822.2012.01775.x = Liu et al 2012 Cell Microbiol, resolves via Crossref. Title verbatim names ECH0825 a type IV secretion effector translocated to host mitochondria. UniProt Q2GG12 = ECH_0825, E. chaffeensis Arkansas (matches; ECH_RS03425 RefSeq). Etf-1 = ECH0825 = Ehrlichia translocated factor 1.
